newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Eriks buys German Heusinger & Salmon.
newsitem.headline: Eriks buys German Heusinger & Salmon.

text.p: Dutch technical wholesaler Eriks Holding NV said on Friday it will buy Germany's Heusinger & Salmon Gruppe on January 1, 1997.
Heusinger & Salmon is a wholesaler of hydraulic, pneumatic and mechanical equipment with 130 employees and expected 1996 turnover of about 60 million guilders.
"Heusinger & Salmon Gruppe is expected to contribute positively to profits from the start," Eriks said in a statement.
Eriks said Heusinger's product range, clients and suppliers fit very well with those of its own subsidiaries.

Added to German companies taken over by Eriks in previous years this takeover will give the company a combined geographical area in Germany that directly connects it with the activities in the Netherlands and Belgium, it added.
Eriks said it would pay the takeover sum from its own funds but gave no financial details of the transaction.
